parameters.name: AliyunOrderId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud order. The value can be the ID of a virtual order.

parameters.name: PackageType
parameters.description:
The plan type. Valid values:

*   single_node_subscribe: Single-node Edition (Subscription).
*   single_node_long_term: Single-node Edition (Long-term).
*   primary_backup_subscribe: HA Edition (Subscription).
*   primary_backup_long_term: HA Edition (Long-term).
*   pre_generation_long_term: Pre-generated (Long-term).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: PurchaseChannel
parameters.description: The purchase channel. Valid values: aliyun_market and aliyun_public. aliyun_market specifies Alibaba Cloud Marketplace. aliyun_public specifies the PolarDB buy page.

parameters.name: VirtualOrder
parameters.description: Specifies whether to query only virtual orders.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb describe-license-orders --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --aliyun-order-id 239618016570503 --purchase-channel aliyun_market --package-type single_node_subscribe --virtual-order true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb DescribeLicenseOrders --region cn-hangzhou --AliyunOrderId 239618016570503 --VirtualOrder true --PageSize 30 --PageNumber 1 --PackageType single_node_subscribe --PurchaseChannel aliyun_market
